dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with low-intensity grayscale values across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several thin, linear, high-contrast white marks are visible on the right-lateral dorsal surface, forming intersecting patterns.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct, elevated longitudinal ridge is visible along the central dorsal axis toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear, light-colored scarring patterns (rake marks) are located on the right-side dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast circular aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
